<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Sensors first. THE DISCRIMINATOR IS THE INDEX STATE RECORDED AT PRE — measured, and it is the only mechanism that works. Three earlier candidates are measured DEAD: parent-count catches only --no-ff merges; the reflog subject catches ff-pull, cherry-pick, revert and amend; and `.git` state (MERGE_HEAD/SQUASH_MSG) DOES NOT EXIST when our hook runs — MERGE_HEAD is never written by --squash at all, and SQUASH_MSG is unlinked by git before even git's own post-commit hook fires. SEVEN transitions are byte-identical to a real authored commit on all three: merge --squash, cherry-pick -n, revert -n, git apply, checkout REF -- path, restore --source, and read-tree -m -u (which is how git subtree works). At PRE, every one of those has an ALREADY-STAGED index while a genuine agent edit has a CLEAN one. Its only error mode is a false NEGATIVE, which is the direction our doctrine demands. It does not solve a HUMAN committing inside the PRE/POST bracket — nothing does, because nothing in git records who typed. That case is known and accepted, not mitigated.

| tk-000d | Add a SECOND guard layer: scan the PRE payload's tool_input.command for content-importing operations | — | phase-1 | [x] checked | — | src/services/hooks/scan-command.ts — segment-aware scan (&& \|\| ; \| newline). 36 unit tests + 5 defeater-inside-bracket rows + 3 KNOWN-BLIND rows. Layer mutations: command-scan-only OFF = 5 RED, index-only OFF = 7 RED (disjoint), both OFF = 12 RED (exact union). | — | MEASURED 2026-08-09 from /tmp/cursor-hook-pre.jsonl (76 records): Cursor issues chained git commands in ONE Shell tool call — the captured line is `git add -A && git commit --trailer ... -m ...`. So defeater-inside-one-bracket is the NORMAL shape, not an exotic case, and index-at-PRE alone does not catch it: PRE sees a clean index because the defeater has not run yet. The same PRE record carries tool_name and tool_input.command, so interrogate the bracket directly. Refuse to emit when the command names merge (with or without --squash), cherry-pick, revert, am, apply, rebase, read-tree, checkout/restore with a source ref or pathspec, reset, stash pop/apply, or subtree. PARSE PER SEGMENT split on && ; \|\| and newline — the defeater and the commit are different segments of one line, so a scan of the first token misses it every time. This NARROWS, it does not close: a script, alias, shell function, Makefile target or heredoc hides the operation, and those rows are asserted as EMIT and labelled KNOWN-BLIND alongside the human-in-the-bracket row. It is a SECOND layer over index-at-PRE, never a replacement — mutate each layer separately AND both together, because a single-layer negation passes while the other layer silently covers for it. Like every other check it may only move the answer TOWARD silence, adding no new false-positive path. | — | [ac-0003](../../../plan.dd.md#acceptance-criteria) |
